learning: Increased controller gains and sensor weights to better leverage stable geometry and early rear sensor detection, aiming to reduce line loss and improve progress.
rationale: The race data shows the current geometry with wheel_track 0.18 and rear sensors at y = -0.035 provides stable lateral stability and early line detection, but the robot still fails to complete the track, with line loss events occurring once per run and progress capped around 0.11-0.12. The controller needs stronger gains and sensor weights to better exploit this geometry. I increased the controller gains (kp, ki, kd) and base_speed moderately to improve responsiveness and control authority, while keeping the line_loss strategy as 'search_left' to maintain consistency. Sensor weights are adjusted to emphasize the central and rear sensors more positively, and the negative weights on outer sensors are slightly increased to sharpen correction. The observation request includes all previously requested measurements plus steering_oscillation and control_effort to monitor control stability and effort. I expect these changes to reduce line loss events, improve progress, and potentially achieve completion in the final iteration.
